title: Lower bound ∫_A g dμ > c for |g| ≤ 1, g = 1 on C ⊆ A, g = 0 off S, c + μ(S ∖ C) < μ(C)
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ, μ a measure on ℝ^P, g : ℝ^P → ℝ Borel with |g(x)| ≤ 1 for all x, and A, C, S ⊆ ℝ^P Borel with C ⊆ A and μ(S) < ∞. Assume g = 1 on C, g = 0 off S, and c ∈ [0, ∞] satisfies c + μ(S ∖ C) < μ(C). Then c < ENNReal.ofReal(∫_A g dμ).
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Eucl P)) (g : Eucl P → ℝ) (A C S : Set (Eucl P)) (c : ℝ≥0∞), MeasurableSet A → MeasurableSet C → MeasurableSet S → C ⊆ A → μ S < ∞ → Measurable g → (∀ x, |g x| ≤ 1) → (∀ x ∈ C, g x = 1) → (∀ x, x ∉ S → g x = 0) → c + μ (S \ C) < μ C → c < ENNReal.ofReal (∫ x in A, g x ∂μ)
